hypotheses.fact: ColumnName is set by the by-name route, so a member that differs from the column name is emitted as '<col> as [<Member>]'; a case-insensitive match emits the bare column (select category, [1] as [Q1], [2] as [Q2]).
Declared names are returned verbatim and convention-only names are derived after From<T>() registration; an unregistered entity resolves to the empty string (never silently defaulted).

The pivot renderer registers the TableAlias source (SqlSourceRenderer.MakePivot -> ctx.ColumnsProvider.Add(typeof(TableAlias), false)) before the select list is rendered, so by-name columns bind with no 'entity source parameter' failure.
